name: Auto Attribute Assigner
author: NorixIT

sections.description:
Auto Attribute Assigner lets you define, per product category, which WooCommerce product attributes (and optional default values) should be applied to products in that category. When you create a product in a matching category, the attributes are added automatically – no more setting the same attributes by hand on every new product.

This version is completely free with no feature limits.

Features

  • Create as many category rules as you like, each with as many attributes as you need.
  • Optional default value per attribute.
  • Attributes are assigned automatically when a product is first created.
  • Attributes are not re-added on every product update, so attributes you removed do not reappear.
  • Manual “Assign” button in the product’s attribute section to pull the presets for a product on demand.
  • “Assign presets to all products” button to apply the presets to your whole existing catalogue at once.
  • Available in English and German (de_DE).

If this plugin saves you time, you can support its ongoing development with a small donation using the “Support / Donate” button in the plugin – thank you!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Go to Auto Attribute Assigner in the admin menu and create your category rules.
sections.faq:
How do I assign attributes to a category?

Open Auto Attribute Assigner, select a product category, check the attributes you want (and optionally set a default value), then save the rule. New products created in that category will receive the attributes automatically.

Why don’t my existing products get the attributes automatically?

Attributes are assigned automatically only when a product is first created, so the plugin never overwrites or re-adds attributes on later edits. To apply the presets to products that already exist, use the “Assign presets to all products” button on the settings page, or the manual “Assign” button on a single product.

Does the plugin remove attributes?

No. Deleting a rule never removes attributes that were already written to your products.
sections.changelog:
3.0

  • New: Role based permission matrix – decide per user role who may see the plugin, create or edit rules, delete rules, use the “Assign” button on a product and run the bulk assignment.
  • New: Roles without the “See plugin” right get no menu entry and no entry in the plugins list – for them the plugin looks as if it were not installed.
  • Security: Only real administrators (manage_options + administrator role, or Super Admin) can change the permissions. A shop role with manage_options can no longer grant itself more rights.
  • Security: Every action is checked again on the server side (saving, deleting, bulk assign, AJAX assign), not only hidden in the interface.
  • New: Filters for developers – autoatas_user_can, autoatas_permissions_capability, autoatas_permissions_require_administrator_role,

2.2

  • New: Role based permission matrix – decide per user role who may see the plugin, create or edit rules, delete rules, use the “Assign” button on a product and run the bulk assignment.
  • New: Users whose role may not see the plugin get no menu entry and no entry in the plugins list – for them the plugin looks as if it were not installed.
  • Security: Every action is checked again on the server (saving, deleting, bulk assign, AJAX assign), not only hidden in the interface.
  • Security: Administrators always keep full access and cannot be locked out.
  • Improved: The permission setting of 2.1 (single capability) is migrated into the new matrix automatically. The filter “autoatas_bulk_assign_capability” still works; the new filter “autoatas_user_can” overrides any check.
  • Improved: “How to use” page extended (category hierarchy, column layout, permissions) and all output properly escaped.
  • Improved: Translations for German (de_DE) and English (en_US) updated.
  • New: The “Assign presets to all products” button can be restricted to a capability; default is install_plugins (administrators only).
  • Improved: Attribute selection uses a grid layout with white cards, highlighted active attributes and a 1/2/3 column switcher.
  • Improved: The category select shows the full category hierarchy – sub-categories are indented below their parent category.
  • Improved: Each category name is followed by its slug in brackets, so categories with the same name can be told apart.
  • Improved: The full path is shown on hover and below the select after selection (e.g. “Shoes > Women”).
  • Improved: The saved rules table shows the full category path instead of only the slug.

2.1

  • Improved: The category select now shows the full category hierarchy – sub-categories are indented below their parent category.
  • Improved: Each category name is followed by its slug in brackets, so categories with the same name can be told apart.
  • Improved: The full path is shown on hover and below the select after selection (e.g. “Shoes > Women”).
  • Improved: The saved rules table now shows the full category path instead of only the slug; categories that no longer exist are marked.
  • Note: Existing rules stay valid, no migration required.

2.0

  • The plugin is now completely free with no feature limits (unlimited category rules and unlimited attributes per rule).
  • Attributes are now assigned automatically only when a product is first created – no longer on every product update, so attributes you removed no longer reappear on the next save.
  • Existing products are no longer modified automatically; use the manual or bulk assign buttons to fill them.
  • New: manual “Assign” button in the product’s attribute section.
  • New: “Assign presets to all products” button for bulk assignment across the whole catalogue.
  • New: English and German (de_DE) language packs.
  • New: “Support / Donate” button.
  • Security: deleting a rule is now protected with a nonce (CSRF protection).
  • Now maintained by Norix IT Support & Webdesign e.U.
  • Tested with PHP 8.2, WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.1.

1.3

  • Bugfixes.
  • German language pack.

1.2

  • Bug fixes and optimizations.

1.1

  • Initial plugin release.
